select.foreach: select flow_task_record_id as flowTaskRecordId, #{item.startTime} as time, sum(bandwidth) as bandwidth ,sum(packets) as packets, sum(tcp_connect_success) as tcpConnectSuccess ,sum(tcp_connect_try) as tcpConnectTry from mp_flow_flow_task_count where flow_generator_id = #{flowGeneratorId} and create_time >= #{item.startTime} and create_time < #{item.endTime} group by flow_task_record_id

select flow_id as flowId, #{item.startTime} as time, sum(bandwidth) as bandwidth,sum(packets) as packets, sum(tcp_connect_success) as tcpConnectSuccess , sum(tcp_connect_try) as tcpConnectTry from mp_flow_flow_task_count where flow_generator_id = #{flowGeneratorId} AND flow_task_record_id = #{flowTaskRecordId} and create_time >= #{item.startTime} and create_time < #{item.endTime} group by flow_id
